entities.summary: Loretta A. Preska is an American lawyer who serves as a senior United States district judge of the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York. Born in Albany, Preska received law degrees from Fordham University School of Law and New York University School of Law. She practiced law in New York City from 1973 to 1992 at the law firms of Cahill Gordon & Reindel and Hertzog, Calamari & Gleason. President George H. W. Bush appointed her to the district bench in 1992. She served as chief judge of the court for a seven-year term from 2009 to 2016, and took senior status in 2017.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a senior United States district judge of the Southern District of New York, Loretta Preska has played a crucial role in shaping the judicial landscape of the region. Her seven-year tenure as chief judge from 2009 to 2016 has had a lasting impact on the court's operations and decisions.
